acceptance_gate.condition: in_domain_judge_auroc present AND shuffled_label_control_auroc present AND ood_judge_auroc present
acceptance_gate.principle: An OOD-transfer claim requires an in-domain sanity pass AND a shuffled-label adversarial control -- without both the OOD number could be a degenerate-prior artifact.

field_principles.confidence_only_baseline_auroc: The bar the judge must beat OOD (exp3646 found confidence 0.882 beat the toy judge 0.673).
field_principles.duration_s: Plausibility floor (a real train+eval takes minutes, not seconds).
field_principles.in_domain_judge_auroc: Sanity: the trained judge must work in-domain before any OOD claim is meaningful.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Trains a head on real embeddings of cached labels + scores cached corpora; declares GPU/CPU + substrate.
field_principles.judge_substrate: The REAL substrate used (GGUF embedding model / small transformer) -- the key difference from the .334 toy numpy head.
field_principles.ood_domains_tested: Which OOD domains (code/facts) were evaluated -- scopes the transfer claim.
field_principles.ood_judge_auroc: The core number: does the real-substrate trained judge detect errors OOD?
field_principles.real_substrate_vs_toy_head_ood_delta: Did a real substrate buy OOD transfer the .334 toy head lacked? -- the resourcing-vs-method question.
field_principles.shuffled_label_control_auroc: Adversarial control: ~0.5 confirms the judge is not learning a degenerate length/format prior.
field_principles.trained_judge_transfers_ood: BARE bool. True iff the real-substrate judge beats BOTH confidence-only and shuffled-control OOD.

judge_recipe.loss: AdamW binary cross-entropy on math error_label; score is P(error).
judge_recipe.train_eval_split: 80/20 stratified FoVer math split per seed; OOD labels are never used for training.
